issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to implement init_world(width, height) (two parameters) to set dimensions, but the template repository does not provide any init_world stub for students to implement. The solution repository does include an init_world label, however it only reads one argument ([esp+4]) and its comment explicitly says “Only handles width”, i.e. it does not implement the two-parameter behavior required by the problem text. This mismatch (problem → expected two-arg init_world; template → no stub; solution → one-arg handling) is likely to confuse students who will look for the declared function to implement and expect both width and height to be handled.
issues.suggested_fix: Either remove the unrelated requirement from the problem statement if init_world is not part of this exercise, or make the requirement consistent across artifacts: add a clear init_world(width, height) stub to the template (e.g. label with a TODO and expected stack layout) and update the solution to properly accept and handle both parameters (e.g. read width from [esp+4] and height from [esp+8] and document calling convention). This ensures students have the expected stub to implement and that the solution demonstrates the two-parameter behavior described in the problem text.
